info.name: Security Gateway - Demo & Test Suite
info.description:
Bo test cho do an Security Gateway.

**Thu tu chay:** 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 (6 tuy chon).
Bien moi truong: `gateway` (http://localhost), `backend` (http://localhost:5000). Import kem file *SecurityGateway.postman_environment.json*.

item.name: 0. Kiem tra he thong

exec: pm.test("Thoi gian Lua kiem tra < 5 ms (5000 us): " + us + " us", () => pm.expect(us).to.be.below(5000));

request.description: Request sach qua Gateway. Xem tab *Headers* cua response: `X-Inspection-Time-Us` la thoi gian rieng cua bo loc Lua (micro giay).
Mo `http://localhost/admin/dashboard` tren trinh duyet de xem realtime khi chay cac request chan.

item.description: Chay truoc tien de chac chan Docker da len.

item.name: 1. TRANG THAI 1 - Tan cong TRUC TIEP Backend (:5000, khong Gateway)

exec: pm.test("Backend thuc thi cau SQL bi chen (HTTP 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Xem log backend: `docker compose logs backend` co dong `[EXECUTING SQL]` chua payload.

item.name: 1.2 UNION SELECT - lo cau truc CSDL

exec: pm.test("LO cau truc bang (CREATE TABLE)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("CREATE TABLE"));

request.description: Dung bang `sqlite_master` de doc toan bo schema database.

item.name: 1.3 UNION SELECT - lay bai viet noi bo (articles)

exec: pm.test("LO tai lieu noi bo", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("noi bo"));

item.name: 1.4 Mass Assignment - tu nang quyen is_admin

request.description: **Thay doi du lieu that.** Reset: `docker compose down -v` roi `up -d`.

item.name: 1.5 Xac nhan chauhoangphu da thanh admin

exec: pm.test("chauhoangphu is_admin = true (da bi leo thang dac quyen)", () => pm.expect(u.is_admin).to.eql(true));

item.description: CANH BAO: thu muc nay lam thay doi du lieu SQLite. Chay xong nen reset bang `docker compose down -v`.

item.name: 2. TRANG THAI 2 - Cung payload qua GATEWAY (:80) -> bi chan

request.description: **Anh minh chung muc 3.7.** Sau do xem `docker compose logs gateway` (co [SECURITY_ALERT]) va `docker compose logs backend` (KHONG con [EXECUTING SQL]).

item.name: 2A.7 Tham do loi: chi 1 dau nhay '

request.description: Chi bi chan khi `STRICT_MODE = true` (mac dinh).
Gateway doi comment `/**/` thanh khoang trang truoc khi so Regex.

item.name: 2A.10 Ne tranh: ma hoa URL (%27 OR %271%27=%271)

request.description: Giong payload trong log Docker cu. Gateway giai ma toi 3 lop.

item.name: 2B. Command Injection / Path Traversal qua Gateway -> 403
2C. API Injection / Mass Assignment qua Gateway -> 403

request.description: **Anh minh chung muc 3.8.** Xem log JSON: `gateway/logs/security_alerts.json`.

item.name: 2C.2 Leo thang dac quyen: role + is_admin

request.description: Bi bat o module SQLi (chuoi doc hai) truoc khi toi kiem tra kieu.

item.name: 2C.5 Type Confusion: age la chuoi thuong

request.description: Chuoi vo hai nhung SAI KIEU -> chi whitelist schema bat duoc.
Hacker doi Content-Type de ne parse JSON; Gateway van nhan dien va chan.

item.name: 2C.11 SQLi nam trong gia tri JSON

item.description: Moi request ky vong **403 Forbidden** + JSON. Backend khong nhan request nao (kiem tra `docker compose logs backend`).

item.name: 3. Request SACH - phai di qua (200)
3.2 Tu khoa trung ten lenh (cat, id)

request.description: Khong co ky tu noi lenh (; && |) nen khong bi nham la Command Injection.

item.description: Chung minh Gateway KHONG chan nham luu luong hop le (False Positive = 0 tren tap nay).

item.name: 4. Han che da biet - False Positive

exec: pm.test("[HAN CHE] STRICT_MODE chan nham chuoi hop le (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

request.description: Minh hoa nhuoc diem muc 4.2: luat dau nhay don gay False Positive. Dat `STRICT_MODE = false` thi se 200 (khi do test nay se FAIL - dung nhu mong doi).

item.name: 4.2 Van ban co dau cham phay

exec: pm.test("[HAN CHE] STRICT_MODE chan nham (403)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: 5.1 API log: cac luot chan moi nhat

exec: pm.test("Co thong ke: tong luot chan > 0", () => pm.expect(j.stats.total).to.be.above(0));
pm.test("Ban ghi co du truong", () => ["timestamp","client_ip","method","uri","attack_type","payload"].forEach(k => pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k)));

request.description: Chinh la du lieu Dashboard dang doc. Ban ghi dau tien la luot chan **moi nhat**.

exec: pm.test("200 (binh thuong) hoac 429 (bi gioi han toc do)", () => pm.expect([200, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bat `RATE_LIMIT = true` trong `gateway/lua/security_check.lua`, `docker compose restart gateway`, roi chay request nay bang **Runner** voi 120 iterations, delay 0 ms. Tu request thu 101 se nhan 429. Xong nho tat lai.
